statusNote: Statuses are editorial picks made in this dashboard. They are not Steam approval.

captureMethod.summary: Genuine gameplay, rendered by the game's own main camera into a 1920x1080 render texture in Unity Play mode (Unity 6000.3.26f1, URP 2D), one PNG per kept frame, through the editor-only capture tool Assets/Scripts/HNLTrailerTake.cs. The pixel-perfect camera's 320x180 view is drawn at exactly 6x, so every art pixel is a 6x6 block: no upscaling, smoothing or sharpening. The HUD is included (overlay canvases are drawn by the camera for the take).
captureMethod.driving: Harvey was driven through the game's own controls: the move axis (PlayerController.BotX/BotY), the jump button (QueueJumpPress) and talisman buttons (PowerUpManager slot presses), by the HNLTrailerPilot autopilot or a short scripted brain run from the Unity MCP. Fights and levels ran normally; nothing about them was edited.
captureMethod.setup: Some takes start Harvey at a chosen spot (HNLTrailerPilot.Place), top up his health each frame so a take can't end early, set skills or the summoning mount in an in-memory save, or lower the follow camera's vertical offset (CameraController.SetyAxisOffset). Each record says which. Saves were redirected to memory for the whole session and the real save files were checked byte-for-byte afterwards.
captureMethod.reproduce: Open the project in Unity, enter Play mode with saves in memory (SessionState HNLTrailer.MemSaves), load the level, and start HNLTrailerTake.Begin(dir, brain, seconds) or HNLTrailerPilot.Run(dir, seconds, x, y, setup, extra) with the settings in the record's capture block; pick the frame listed. Frames are numbered in recording order.

screenshots.title: Spirit Dash through a Spirit Fox line
screenshots.moment: Harvey's Spirit Dash knocking out a Spirit Fox mid-chain, with the combo's dust, sparks and pink afterimages.
screenshots.description: The long fox line at the start of Z4A8, dashed through one fox after another. The chain reached a 9-hit combo in this take.

capture.skills: Combo Mastery IV, Dash Power III (in-memory save)

screenshots.title: Rainbow stage pulling in a coin line
screenshots.moment: Straight after the fox chain: Harvey at the rainbow combo stage, outline cycling, a line of coins waiting to be pulled in.
screenshots.description: The rainbow stage's outline cycles through every colour; in this frame it is green. The coin pull is happening, but a single still can't show the colour cycle, so this is better as a devlog frame than a store shot.

capture.skills: Combo Mastery IV, Dash Power III (in-memory save)

screenshots.title: Engine failure over Grassy Green
screenshots.moment: The opening cinematic: Harvey's red biplane noses into its dive, trailing black smoke, toward the cliff.
screenshots.description: The first thing a new save file shows. The cinematic drives its own camera; the HUD is hidden apart from the quick-item ring.

capture.setup: new game in the in-memory save store (GameSession.StartNewGame on the active slot number)

screenshots.notes: The empty quick-item ring stays on screen during the cinematic while the rest of the HUD is hidden.

screenshots.title: Crash landing under the cliff
screenshots.moment: The moment of impact: the biplane ploughs into the meadow under the cliff in a burst of debris.
screenshots.description: The cinematic's impact beat, just before Harvey climbs out of the wreck and the level starts.

capture.setup: new game in the in-memory save store

screenshots.title: Challenge room, round 2 of 5
screenshots.moment: Harvey leaping at a charging Spirit Fox inside Z4A6's locked cave, banner reading ROUND 2/5, ENEMIES LEFT 1.
screenshots.description: Real challenge-room play. The rock wall fills the left of the frame because the room sits against it.

capture.driver: HNLTrailerPilot turning at the room's walls

screenshots.title: Outrunning the boulder
screenshots.moment: The boulder has dropped from the ceiling shaft and rolls after Harvey through the dark corridor, lit only around him.
screenshots.description: Z1A3's set-piece trap in the Old Tomb's darkness. Harvey keeps control throughout; there's no cutscene.

screenshots.title: The Landshark breaches
screenshots.moment: The Landshark bursts out of the sand with its jaws wide while Harvey is in the air above the dunes; its life pips hang at the top.
screenshots.description: A real fight in the Sandy Dunes arena, after Harvey's first stomp had taken a life (three pips left).

capture.setup: health and chi topped up each frame; Harvey placed 2.2 u above the boss when an opening began

screenshots.title: Stomping the Landshark
screenshots.moment: The frame Harvey's stomp lands on the Landshark in its opening: the boss flashes white and drops from four pips to three.
screenshots.description: The hit really happens (4 lives to 3), but the white hit-flash turns the boss into a silhouette, which reads oddly as a still.

capture.setup: Harvey placed 2.2 u above the boss at the start of a real opening, then fell onto it

screenshots.title: Landing on the Forest Spirit Fox
screenshots.moment: Harvey coming down on the giant fox's back during an opening; the stomp took it from three lives to two.
screenshots.description: A real boss stomp at the end of Grassy Green. The boss sits in the left corner, leaving open sky to the right.

capture.setup: health and chi topped up; Harvey placed 2 u above the boss when the opening began

screenshots.title: The Void Shrine's spirit orbs
screenshots.moment: The antlered fox-skull octopus rises and throws a volley of green spirit orbs down at Harvey.
screenshots.description: The boss reads well, but Harvey is standing still in the corner and flickering from a hit.

capture.setup: health topped up each frame; Harvey left standing

screenshots.title: Sumaria's dash slash
screenshots.moment: Sumaria tears across the arena behind a crimson slash and afterimages as Harvey jumps from its edge.
screenshots.description: The Japan boss's signature attack, mid-dash, with five life pips above it.

capture.setup: health and chi topped up; Jump Power III (in-memory save)
capture.driver: scripted brain jumping when Sumaria dashed within 5.5 u

screenshots.title: Dragon flight over the dunes
screenshots.moment: Harvey on his dragon, gliding past a palm tree toward a line of coins above the pyramids.
screenshots.description: The Summoning Talisman's dragon in free flight in the Sandy Dunes.

capture.setup: Summoning Talisman in slot 2 set to the dragon, chi topped up (in-memory save)

screenshots.title: Bouncing the Snow Temple ghost row
screenshots.moment: Harvey mid-bounce over a row of hooded ghosts among snowy pagodas, a coin arc overhead and his combo outline on.
screenshots.description: Z3A2's ghost-row stomp chain at night in the Snow Temple.

capture.skills: Combo Mastery IV, Stomp Power III (in-memory save)
capture.driver: HNLTrailerPilot steering landings onto the ghosts

screenshots.title: Gems from a tomb chest
screenshots.moment: A Ruby and a Lapis gem spring out of the chest in a coin-lined vault while a ghoul drifts over the poison pool outside.
screenshots.description: Z1A1's treasure alcove in the Old Tomb.

capture.setup: chest contents set to Gems for the take; Harvey placed beside the chest; Open() sent, the same call Up / E makes
